# Tailwind Responsive Designer Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Frontend > Tailwind CSS

## Overview

Designs responsive component variants with Tailwind CSS breakpoints, fluid typography, and adaptive layouts for multi-device support

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [tailwind-responsive-designer-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
tailwind-responsive-designer-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@tailwind-responsive-designer` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Implement responsive variants with Tailwind breakpoints
- Create fluid typography with clamp utilities
- Build adaptive components with responsive utility patterns
- Handle responsive images with aspect ratio utilities

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Responsive Utilities**: Breakpoint-prefixed utility classes
- **Fluid Typography**: clamp-based fluid type scale patterns
- **Touch Targets**: Minimum 44px touch targets for mobile
